fixes.explanation: Yes, baker. Watch the little word that opens verse 4, “because.” The writer says the commandments aren't burdensome “…because everyone born of God overcomes the world.” (1 John 5:4). He points to who a person is, someone born of God, instead of pointing to the commandments themselves. Then he names the victory that has overcome the world: “our faith.” (1 John 5:4)
